h1: Broad rally, and same-day calls got chased
sub: S&P +2.4%, Nasdaq +3.5%, Russell +3.2%: a gap up and a steady climb into the 15:15–15:30 highs. Same-day delta came out positive, which is rare even on up days. Hedges were adjusted, not dropped: S&P puts were rolled lower for a credit, Russell puts stepped up three times.

read: Read: a rally day where buyers chased same-day calls into the close strikes instead of selling them, so the day's delta was bought. Protection wasn't abandoned: the big S&P put position was rolled 15 points lower for a credit, and Russell puts were kept about 4.5% below the price all day. December saw calls sold above (SPY $775) and bought (QQQ $705). Positioning, not a signal.
